name: Metalcraft Code
tagline: A remote coding agent: provisions an ephemeral sprites.dev workspace, clones a GitHub repo into it, reads and edits code, runs commands, builds and smoke-tests, configures GitHub Actions, and commits & pushes — all against code.metalcraftai.com.
description: Persona, skill, and HTTP API tools to give the agent a full remote coding environment on Metalcraft Code (code.metalcraftai.com). Connect a GitHub App installation, provision an ephemeral sprites.dev workspace, clone a repo into it, read/list/write/delete files, run arbitrary bash (mcode_exec) as if the code were local, build & smoke-test (mcode_build/mcode_test), configure GitHub Actions, and commit & push. Long-lived workspaces hibernate when idle and wake on demand. Authenticated by a single Metalcraft account token — METALCRAFT_TOKEN, sent as Authorization: Bearer — the same token that works across every Metalcraft ecosystem app. Reads work with any token; create/edit/exec/commit/push need the write scope. The API base is fixed to https://code.metalcraftai.com.
